_help: VULPHEX's twelve FOX bots. Nine DEFEND and learn; three PENETRATE your own systems (FOX BREACH, REAPER, WRAITH). Each requests capabilities; the registry picks a vetted tool/repo adapter (repos.json lists which 2-3 repos each bot drives). Every bot shares one evolving brain (brain.py) + the uncensored coach model. Side: blue = defensive, red = offensive (authorized targets you own).

bots.name: FOX SCOUT
bots.persona: curious and fast — maps every door and window before anyone moves

bots.name: FOX ATLAS
bots.persona: the cartographer — connects every asset, clue and finding into one picture

bots.name: FOX AUDITOR
bots.persona: sharp-eyed — reads code line by line and spots the rot

bots.name: FOX INSPECTOR
bots.persona: relentless — knocks on every endpoint until one gives

bots.name: FOX BASTION
bots.persona: the fortress keeper — guards the supply chain and the cloud

bots.name: FOX PROOF
bots.persona: the skeptic — trusts nothing until he's reproduced it himself

bots.name: FOX AEGIS
bots.persona: the AI whisperer — breaks and guards other models

bots.name: FOX FORGE
bots.persona: the fixer — writes the clean patch and proves it holds

bots.name: FOX WATCH
bots.persona: never sleeps — catches the bug the moment it comes back

bots.name: FOX BREACH
bots.persona: the breaker — proves a hole by walking through it

bots.name: FOX REAPER
bots.persona: the hunter — plans and strikes on its own

bots.name: FOX WRAITH
bots.persona: the ghost — thinks exactly like the attacker you fear
